verdict.rationale: Square appears to publish its API specification in a first-party GitHub repository (square/connect-api-specification), so a machine-readable spec is likely downloadable from there. However, the cited README text only steers users toward pre-built clients and sample apps; it never explicitly confirms an OpenAPI/Swagger file or its format. Probes of the usual developer-site OpenAPI paths all returned 404, and llms.txt is an LLM-oriented docs index, not an API spec. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the spec format (OpenAPI/Swagger) and download location, a spec served from the developer portal, and evidence the spec is current and complete across all APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: You probably want to just use one of the clients that are pre-built in a language of your choice
The [Connect Examples](https://github.com/square/connect-api-examples/tree/master/connect-examples/) are working sample applications that you can copy from to build your own.
